summary.tldr: Implements the 2023 Canada-Ukraine Free Trade Agreement and repeals the 2017 implementation law.
what_it_does: Approves the 2023 Canada-Ukraine Free Trade Agreement.
Sets out rules for how the law and the agreement are to be read and applied.
Bars legal action under sections 9 to 15, related orders, or the agreement itself without the Attorney General of Canada’s consent.
Gives the Governor in Council power to make orders under the agreement.
Requires Canada to pay its share of the agreement’s institutional and administrative costs.
Amends certain Acts to carry out Canada’s obligations under the agreement.
who_it_affects: Businesses trading between Canada and Ukraine
summary.background: The bill implements the Canada-Ukraine Free Trade Agreement, done at Ottawa on September 22, 2023. It also repeals the Canada-Ukraine Free Trade Agreement Implementation Act enacted in 2017.
